```{r}
#| label: synthetic-data3


set.seed(1)

  N <- 148 # Number of participants
  K <- 8 # number of measurement types

  # The formula for the pre-intervention variables
  form_pre <- ~ 1 +  age + sex

  # beta_pre is a p * K matrix of parameter (p in 1 to P)
  # values for each type (k in 1:K).
  # fmt: skip
  betas_pre <- matrix(
  c(rep(0, K), # intercepts
    runif(8, -0.15, 0.15),  # age
    0, 0, 0, 0.2, 0, -0.2, 0.15, 0.15  # sex
  ),
  nrow = 3,
  ncol = K,
  byrow = TRUE
)

  # The same formula for both time-points
  form_main <- ~  pre + group + sex

  # betas matrix are p * K
  # fmt: skip
  
  beta_pre <- runif(8, 0.7, 0.95)
  
  betas_t1 <- matrix(
  c(rep(0, K), # intercepts
    beta_pre, # pre_k effect 
    c(0.4, 0, 0, 0, 0.4, 0, 0, 0), # group
    rep(0, 8)   # sex
  ),
  nrow = 4,
  ncol = K,
  byrow = TRUE
)

  # fmt: skip
  betas_t2 <-  matrix(
  c(rep(0, K), # intercepts
    beta_pre,  # pre_k effect 
    c(0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 0, -0.2, -0.4, -0.5, 0),  # group
    rep(0, 8)   # sex
  ),
  nrow = 4,
  ncol = K,
  byrow = TRUE
)

  
  
  # Predictor variables, used in *all* sims
  preds_all <- data.frame(
    group = rep(c(0, 1), each = N / 2),
    sex = rep(c(0, 1),  N/2 ),
    age = c(runif(N/2, -1.5, 1.5), rnorm(N/2))
  )

  
 
  # Loadings for pre-intervention loading matrix
  # Assuming that 
  
  Lambda1 <- matrix(
  c(0.7,  0.02,
    0.5,  0.01,   
    0.35, 0.01, 
    0.01, 0.4, 
    0.02, 0.35,
    0.03, 0.3, 
    0.01, 0.02, 
    0.001,0.002 
    ), 
                 ncol = 2,
                 byrow = TRUE)
  
  # Error in the factor model
  psi1 <- 1 - rowSums(Lambda1) 
  

  
  # Transform to loadings
  Lambda1 <- sqrt(Lambda1)
  # Add negative correlations
  Lambda1[1,] <- -Lambda1[1,]
  # Pre intervention SD's per type (length K)
  S1 <- rep(1, K)
  
  
   Lambda2a <- matrix(
   c(0.3,   0.02,  0.02, 0.01,
    0.01,  0.2,   0.01, 0.01,
    0.01,  0.01,  0.4,  0.02,
    0.02,  0.01,  0.01, 0.2,
    0.8,   0.02,  0.01, 0.01,
    0.02,  0.3,   0.01, 0.01,
    0.01,  0.02,  0.3,  0.01,
    0.001, 0.002, 0.01, 0.02
    ), 
                 ncol = 4,
                 byrow = TRUE)
  
      Lambda2b <- matrix(
   c(0.32,   0.01,  0.01, 0.02,
    0.01,  0.28,   0.01, 0.02,
    0.02,  0.02,  0.43,  0.02,
    0.02,  0.001,  0.02, 0.2,
    0.75,   0.02,  0.01, 0.01,
    0.02,  0.3,   0.01, 0.01,
    0.01,  0.02,  0.34,  0.01,
    0.001, 0.002, 0.01, 0.02
    ), 
                 ncol = 4,
                 byrow = TRUE)
   

       
  # Error in the factor model
  psi2a <- 1 - rowSums(Lambda2a)
  psi2b <- 1 - rowSums(Lambda2b) 
  
    # Transform to loadings
  Lambda2a <- sqrt(Lambda2a)
  Lambda2b <- sqrt(Lambda2b)
  
    # Add some negative correlations
  Lambda2a[3,] <- -Lambda2a[3,]
  Lambda2b[3,] <- -Lambda2b[3,]
  

  # Pre intervention SD's per type (length K)
  s2a <- rep(1, K); s2b <- rep(1, K) 
  
  
  Lambda2 <- list(Lambda2a, Lambda2b)
  psi2 <- list(psi2a, psi2b)
  S2 <- list(s2a, s2b)
  
  
  # Between time-point (residual) correlations within each type (length K)
  c_cross <- c(0.35, 0.4, 0.3, 0.35, 0.3, 0.35, 0.35, 0.4)

  # missing_form_t2,  formula specifying the predictor for missing values at t2
  miss_t2 <- ~ 1 + age
  miss_t4 <- ~ 1 + age

  # Parameter values for the form complete missingness
  miss_beta_t2 <- c(-2, -0.5)
  miss_beta_t4 <- c(-2, -0.5)

  # Random missing proportion
  miss_prop_pre <- 0.005 # e.g., 2% missing of all rows
  miss_prop_y <- 0.02 # e.g., 5% miss of all rows post-int


  simout <- sim_type2(
    
    n = N,
    K = K,

    form_pre = form_pre,
    betas_pre = betas_pre,

    form = form_main,
    preds = preds_all,
    betas = list(betas_t1, betas_t2),

    Lambda1 = Lambda1, 
    psi1 = psi1, 
    S1 = S1, 
    
    Lambda2 = Lambda2, 
    psi2 = psi2, 
    S2 = S2, 
    
    
    C_cross = c_cross,
    missing_form_t2 = miss_t2,
    missing_form_t4 = miss_t4,
    missing_beta_t2 = miss_beta_t2,
    missing_beta_t4 = miss_beta_t4,
    missing_pre_prop = miss_prop_pre,
    missing_y_prop = miss_prop_y,
    verbose = FALSE
  )


  d3 <- struct_sim(simout$miss, verbose = FALSE)
  

  
```


Using synthetic data we can confirm that the models captures population-level values from the synthetic data (@fig-s9-10-synth-post). 


```{r}
#| label: fig-s9-10-synth-post
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check of treatment contrasts using synthetic data  in models S9 and S10. Values used for simulations are indicated by vertical lines."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12

ds_miss <- d3$dl_itt # Missing data, both time points

ds_miss$prior_only <- 0

refit.models <- FALSE # Should fit_wrap refit models.
# 

fit_wrap(s9, DATA = ds_miss, fit = "fit.synth.s9", refit = FALSE)
fit_wrap(s10, DATA = ds_miss, fit = "fit.synth.s10", refit = FALSE)


# Extract draws 
draws.s9 <- fit.synth.s9$draws(format="df") 
draws.s10 <- fit.synth.s10$draws(format="df")


# Extract "true" values
simparam <- data.frame(type = as.character(rep(1:8, 2)), 
           time = as.character(rep(1:2, each = 8)), 
           true = c(betas_t1[3,], betas_t2[3,]))



# Create graph of posterior densities and true values
bind_rows(
  pred_dat_1(draws.s9, fit_type = 2) |> 
    mutate(model = "s9"), 
  pred_dat_1(draws.s10, fit_type = 2) |> 
    mutate(model = "s10")) |> 
  mutate(contrast = treat2 - treat1) |> 


  
  ggplot(aes(contrast, color = time, lty = model)) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density") +
 
  facet_wrap(~type, labeller = label_both) +
  
  alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  
  geom_vline(data = simparam, 
             aes(xintercept = true, 
                 color = time)) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale) + 
  labs(x = "Contrast", 
       color = "Time", 
       lty = "Model")
  




```

Next we will refit models S9 and S10 with our observed data and update the chain diagnostics and posterior predictive simulations from above.

fit_wrap(s10, DATA = d, fit = "fit.s10.post")

#| eval: true

yrep.s9 <- fit.s9.post$draws("y_rep", format = "df")

# Obs data

  y = d$y_obs, 
  type = d$type, 
    sex = d$sex,
    treat = d$treat, 
  time = d$time
  ) |> 
  filter(y > -900) 

# Set number of draws for posterior predictive checks
ndraws <- 40


# Distribution of observed values vs. distribution of y rep
p1 <- yrep.s9 |> 
  filter(.chain == "1", 
         .iteration %in% 1:ndraws) |> 
  pivot_longer(starts_with("y_rep")) |> 
  mutate(
    type = rep(d$type, ndraws), 
    sex = rep(d$sex, ndraws),
    treat = rep(d$treat, ndraws), 
    time = rep(d$time, ndraws),
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(value, group = .iteration)) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density", 
            alpha = 0.2) + 
  facet_grid(time + treat ~ type, 
             labeller = label_both) +
  
  geom_line(data = dobs, 
            aes(y, group = NULL), 
            stat = "density", 
            color = colscale[3],
            alpha = 0.8,
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  alpha_theme(yaxis = FALSE) + 
  theme(axis.title.y =  element_blank())

p1

  summarise(.by = analyte, 
            m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            s = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) ) |> 
  mutate(threshold_male = c(1.03, 5.6, 1.7, 94, 100, NA, NA, NA), 
         threshold_female = c(1.29, 5.6, 1.7, 80, 100, NA, NA, NA)) |>
  
  mutate(threshold_male = (threshold_male - m)/s, 
         threshold_female = (threshold_female - m)/s) |> 
  mutate(type = dense_rank(analyte)) |> 
  expand_grid(treat = c(1, 2), 
              time = c(1, 2)) |> 
  mutate(Treatment = if_else(treat == 1, "Placebo", "N-3"), 
         Time = if_else(time == 1, "T2", "T4"), 
         treat = as.character(treat), 
         time = as.character(time), 
         type = as.character(type)) |> 
  # dropping thresholds here
  select(-threshold_male, -threshold_female) 
  
  
  
mean_sum <- draws |> 

  select(starts_with("alpha"), .chain, .iteration) |> 
#  filter(.iteration %in% 1:10) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value", 
               cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  mutate(param = gsub("alpha\\[", "", param), 
         param = gsub("\\]", "", param)) |> 
  separate(param, into = c("time", "type", "treat"), sep = ",") |> 
  
  # Include labs
  inner_join(labs) |> 
  # Back-transform
  mutate(value_org = value * s + m) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(analyte, Treatment, Time), 
            m = mean(value_org), 
            lwr5 = quantile(value_org, 0.025), 
            lwr25 = quantile(value_org, 0.25),
            upr75 = quantile(value_org, 0.75),
            upr95 = quantile(value_org, 0.975)) 
  

  
  p1 <- mean_sum |> 
  ggplot(aes(Treatment, m, color = Time)) + 
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr5, ymax = upr95), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr25, ymax = upr75), 
                width = 0, 
                linewidth = 1.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2))  +
  
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), 
             size = 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~ analyte, scales = "free") + 
    labs(y = "Mean (5-25-75-95% percentile)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = colscale) +
    alpha_theme()
  
  ## Plot 2: contrasts
  
  contrats_summary <- draws |> 
    select(starts_with("alpha"), .chain, .iteration) |> 
  # filter(.iteration %in% 1:10) |> 
  pivot_longer(names_to = "param", 
               values_to = "value", 
               cols = starts_with("alpha")) |> 
  mutate(param = gsub("alpha\\[", "", param), 
         param = gsub("\\]", "", param)) |> 
  separate(param, into = c("time", "type", "treat"), sep = ",") |> 
  
  # Include labs
  inner_join(labs) |> 
  # Back-transform
  mutate(value_org = value * s + m) |> 
  select(analyte, Time, Treatment, value_org, .chain, .iteration) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Treatment, 
              values_from = value_org) |> 
  
  mutate(contrast = `N-3` - Placebo) |> 
    summarise(.by = c(analyte, Time), 
            m = mean(contrast), 
            lwr5 = quantile(contrast, 0.025), 
            lwr25 = quantile(contrast, 0.25),
            upr75 = quantile(contrast, 0.75),
            upr95 = quantile(contrast, 0.975)) 
  
  
 p2 <-  contrats_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(Time, m)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr5, ymax = upr95), 
                width = 0, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr25, ymax = upr75), 
                width = 0, 
                linewidth = 1.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2))  +
  
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2), 
             size = 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~ analyte, scales = "free") + 
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "gray80") + 
  
  alpha_theme()
  
  
 
 return(list(contrats_dat = contrats_summary, 
             mean_dat = mean_sum, 
             p1 = p1, 
             p2 = p2))
  
}

#| eval: false

## Extracting diagnostic criteria and running seqwrap

draws.s8 <- fit.s8.post$draws(format = "df")

# In the stan code, diagnosed is indexed as participant p and time t
#  n_criteria[p, t] = count;
#  diagnosed[p, t] = (count >= 3) ? 1.0 : 0.0;

sw_data <- draws.s8 |> 
 # filter(.iteration %in% 1:100) |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(starts_with("diagnosed"), .chain, .iteration) |> 
 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("diagnosed")) |> 
  mutate(name = gsub("diagnosed\\[", "", name), 
         name = gsub("\\]", "", name)) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("participant", "time"), sep = ",") |> 
  mutate(sample_seq = paste0("part_time_", participant,"_", time), 
         chain_iter = paste0("iter", .chain, "_", .iteration)) |> 
  select(chain_iter, sample_seq, value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample_seq, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  data.frame() 

# Create a metadata data frame
sw_md <- data.frame(participant = d$P, 
           treat = d$treat) |> 
  distinct(participant, treat) |> 
  expand_grid(time = c(1, 2, 3)) |> 
  mutate(sample_seq = paste0("part_time_", participant, "_", time), 
         treat = if_else(treat == 1, "placebo", "n3"), 
         time = if_else(time == 1, "t1", 
                        if_else(time == 2, "t2", "t4"))) |> 
  data.frame() |> 
  print()



library(seqwrap)

sw1 <- seqwrap_compose(modelfun = glmmTMB::glmmTMB, 
                arguments = list(
                  formula = y ~ time * treat + (1|participant), 
                  family = stats::binomial
                ), 
                data = sw_data, 
                metadata = sw_md, 
                samplename = "sample_seq")

sw1_results <- seqwrap(sw1, cores = 10)


sw1_sum <- seqwrap_summarise(sw1_results)


sw1_sum$summaries |> 
  filter(term %in% c("timet2:treatplacebo", "timet4:treatplacebo")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(estimate)) + geom_density() + 
  facet_wrap(~ term)
